description: Show the project's context card. In a client that displays MCP Apps, the host draws it in the chat (a mini card in a chat panel). Anywhere else the reply is the card as Markdown: identity, AGENTS.md sections, memory, discovery. format: "markdown" returns the Markdown card in any client, for a user who asks for the card as text. For the original card in a browser, use save_context_card (also GET /card over HTTP).

detail.description: the Markdown card: tldr (default) shows five facts, each cut short; full shows every fact whole

format.description: auto (default): the host draws the card if it displays MCP Apps, else the Markdown card; markdown: the Markdown card in any client

name: render_context_card
title: Render Context Card
